name: Barbarian
equipment: (a) a greataxe or (b) any martial melee weapon
(a) two handaxes or (b) any simple weapon
An explorer's pack and four javelins

toggles.name: Rage
toggles.desc: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, slashing; advantage on STR checks and saves; bonus melee damage

1.name: Rage
1.desc: Bonus action, no heavy armor: advantage on STR checks and saves, rage bonus to STR melee damage, resistance to bludgeoning/piercing/slashing, no spells. 1 min; ends early if you neither attack nor take damage for a turn.

1.name: Unarmored Defense
1.desc: No armor: AC 10 + DEX + CON, shield allowed.

2.name: Reckless Attack
2.desc: On your first attack: advantage on STR melee attacks this turn, but attacks against you are made with advantage until your next turn.

2.name: Danger Sense
2.desc: Advantage on DEX saves against effects you can see, unless blinded, deafened or incapacitated.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.desc: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

7.name: Feral Instinct
7.desc: Advantage on initiative; if surprised you can still act on your first turn by raging first.

9.name: Brutal Critical
9.desc: Melee crits roll extra weapon dice: 1 at 9th level, 2 at 13th, 3 at 17th.

11.name: Relentless Rage
11.desc: Dropping to 0 HP while raging: DC 10 CON save to stay at 1 HP; +5 DC per use, reset by a rest.

13.name: Brutal Critical
13.desc: Melee crits roll extra weapon dice: 1 at 9th level, 2 at 13th, 3 at 17th.

15.name: Persistent Rage
15.desc: Rage lasts the full minute unless you fall unconscious or end it yourself.

17.name: Brutal Critical
17.desc: Melee crits roll extra weapon dice: 1 at 9th level, 2 at 13th, 3 at 17th.

18.name: Indomitable Might
18.desc: A STR check total below your STR score uses the score instead.

3.name: Ancestral Protectors
3.desc: While raging, the first creature you hit each turn has disadvantage on attacks against others, and those it hits resist the damage, until your next turn.

6.name: Spirit Shield
6.desc: Reaction while raging: reduce damage to a creature within 30 ft by 2d6 (3d6 at 10th, 4d6 at 14th).

10.name: Consult the Spirits
10.desc: Augury or Clairvoyance (an ancestral spirit as the sensor) without slot or material, WIS; once per short rest.

14.name: Vengeful Ancestors
14.desc: Damage prevented by Spirit Shield is dealt to the attacker as force.

3.name: Battlerager Armor
3.desc: Raging in spiked armor: bonus action spike attack (1d4 + STR piercing); a successful grapple deals 3 piercing.

6.name: Reckless Abandon
6.desc: Reckless Attack while raging grants temp HP equal to CON (min 1), lost when the rage ends.

10.name: Battlerager Charge
10.desc: Dash as a bonus action while raging.

14.name: Spiked Retribution
14.desc: Raging in spiked armor: creatures within 5 ft that hit you in melee take 3 piercing.

3.name: Form of the Beast
3.desc: While raging grow a natural weapon: bite 1d8 (heals prof bonus when below half HP), claws 1d6 (extra claw attack), or tail 1d8 with reach (reaction +1d8 AC).

6.name: Bestial Soul
6.desc: Natural weapons are magical; after each rest choose swimming and water breathing, climbing (even ceilings), or jumping farther.

10.name: Infectious Fury
10.desc: Natural weapon hit while raging: WIS save or the target attacks a creature you choose with its reaction, or takes 2d12 psychic (prof bonus/long rest).

14.name: Call the Hunt
14.desc: On raging, up to CON mod willing allies within 30 ft add 1d6 to one damage roll per turn; you gain 5 temp HP per ally (prof bonus/long rest).

actions.name: Intimidating Presence
actions.desc: Action: scare one creature within 30 ft, WIS save DC {dc:CHA} or frightened until your next turn ends

3.name: Frenzy
3.desc: Rage in a frenzy: bonus action melee attack each later turn; one level of exhaustion when the rage ends.

6.name: Mindless Rage
6.desc: Can't be charmed or frightened while raging; existing effects are suspended.

10.name: Intimidating Presence
10.desc: Action: a creature within 30 ft WIS save or frightened until your next turn ends, extendable each turn with your action.

14.name: Retaliation
14.desc: Reaction melee weapon attack against a creature within 5 ft that damages you.

toggles.name: Frenzy
toggles.desc: While raging: an extra melee swing each turn (bonus action); +1 exhaustion when you stop

subclasses.name: Giant
subclasses.source: Bigby Presents - Glory of the Giants

3.name: Giant’s Power
3.desc: Learn Giant (or another language) and Druidcraft or Thaumaturgy (WIS).

3.name: Giant’s Havoc
3.desc: While raging: +5 ft reach and Large size; rage damage also applies to STR thrown weapon hits.

6.name: Elemental Cleaver
6.desc: On raging, a held weapon deals acid, cold, fire, thunder or lightning, +1d6 of it, and gains thrown 20/60 returning to your hand.

10.name: Mighty Impel
10.desc: Bonus action while raging: move a Medium or smaller creature in reach up to 30 ft (STR save if unwilling).

14.name: Demiurgic Colossus
14.desc: Raging: +10 ft reach, Large or Huge size, Mighty Impel works on Large creatures, Elemental Cleaver deals 2d6.

3.name: Storm Aura
3.desc: 10 ft aura while raging, activated on rage and as a bonus action: desert deals fire to all, sea a lightning bolt (DEX save), tundra temp HP to allies; scales with level.

6.name: Storm Soul
6.desc: Desert: fire resistance, ignore heat, ignite objects. Sea: lightning resistance, water breathing, swim 30 ft. Tundra: cold resistance, ignore cold, freeze water.

10.name: Shielding Storm
10.desc: Chosen creatures in your aura share your Storm Soul resistance.

14.name: Raging Storm
14.desc: Desert: reaction fire (half barbarian level) on a creature hitting you, DEX save. Sea: reaction to knock prone a creature you hit, STR save. Tundra: aura activation drops a creature's speed to 0, STR save.

3.name: Spirit Seeker
3.desc: Beast Sense and Speak with Animals as rituals.

3.name: Totem Spirit
3.desc: While raging: Bear resists all but psychic; Eagle makes opportunity attacks at disadvantage and Dashes as a bonus action; Wolf gives allies advantage on adjacent enemies; Elk +15 ft; Tiger longer jumps.

6.name: Aspect of the Beast
6.desc: Bear: double carrying capacity. Eagle: sharp sight to a mile. Elk: double travel pace. Tiger: two extra skills. Wolf: track at fast pace, stealthy travel.

10.name: Spirit Walker
10.desc: Commune with Nature as a ritual.

14.name: Totemic Attunement
14.desc: Bear: adjacent enemies have disadvantage attacking others. Eagle: fly while raging. Elk: bonus action trample. Tiger: bonus action attack after a charge. Wolf: knock prone on a hit.

3.name: Magic Awareness
3.desc: Action: sense spells and magic items within 60 ft and their school until your next turn (prof bonus/long rest).

3.name: Wild Surge
3.desc: Entering a rage rolls a random Wild Magic effect; save DC 8 + prof + CON.

6.name: Bolstering Magic
6.desc: Action, touch: +1d3 to attacks and checks for 10 min, or regain a slot of level 1d3 or lower (prof bonus/long rest).

10.name: Unstable Backlash
10.desc: Reaction after taking damage or failing a save while raging: roll a new Wild Magic effect.

14.name: Controlled Surge
14.desc: Roll Wild Magic twice and pick; doubles let you choose any effect.

3.name: Divine Fury
3.desc: While raging, the first creature you hit each turn takes 1d6 + half barbarian level necrotic or radiant.

3.name: Warrior of the Gods
3.desc: Spells that only bring you back to life need no material components.

6.name: Fanatical Focus
6.desc: Once per rage, reroll a failed save.

10.name: Zealous Presence
10.desc: Bonus action: up to ten allies within 60 ft have advantage on attacks and saves until your next turn; once per long rest.

14.name: Rage Beyond Death
14.desc: While raging, 0 HP doesn't knock you out and death waits until the rage ends.
